description:
The image depicts a giraffe standing in front of a wooden fence, with a palm tree and a building in the background. The purpose of the image is to showcase the giraffe and its surroundings.

* A giraffe:
	+ Standing in the center of the image
	+ Facing to the right
	+ Has a long neck and legs
	+ Brown and white spots on its body
* A palm tree:
	+ Located behind the giraffe
	+ Tall and slender
